name: Servo-sentry
community_notes: [APPROX] only the Tempestor Aquilon shoots, and only with its sentry weapon (sentry flamer / sentry grenade launcher / sentry hotshot volley gun), as if it were your Shooting phase

name: Suppression Bombardment
community_notes: Applied via the Wyvern quad stormshard mortar; MONSTER and VEHICLE units cannot be suppressed.

name: Voice of Command

options.name: First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire!

community_notes: Each OFFICER datasheet specifies how many Orders it can issue per battle round and which units are eligible; Orders are issued in your Command phase (and at the end of a phase in which the OFFICER disembarked from a TRANSPORT or was set up). A unit can be affected by only one Order at a time. TAKE COVER! cannot improve a Save to better than 3+. Only ASTRA MILITARUM models benefit from an Order.

name: Masters of Camouflage
community_notes: [APPROX] Save +1 (to a max of 3+) applies only when the WALKER/REGIMENT model already has Benefit of Cover for another reason (e.g. wholly within a Ruin); the cap and the 'other reason' gate are simplified. Applies to ASTRA MILITARUM WALKER and REGIMENT models. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Iron Tread
community_notes: [APPROX] Applies to SQUADRON units on Advance (no Advance roll, +6" Move). The clause allowing the Advance move to pass through — but not end within — enemy Engagement Range is not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Mechanised Spearhead
community_notes: [APPROX] Triggers when a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM REGIMENT unit disembarks from a Transport within 6" of this model, letting it issue 1 Order to that unit regardless of Orders already issued; the disembark trigger and order bypass are collapsed into an opaque grant. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Brutal Disciplinarian
community_notes: [APPROX] The selected unit must be Battle-shocked and contain 2+ models, and the cost — one model in that unit is destroyed — is not encoded; the selector captures only the friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY within 12" constraint. Full rule in raw-text store.
